default/32518.htm.text: Vortex: Vortex of confusion... One piece... Mysterious power... You would get something from here. (This place is for those who are able to transform into Flying Transformed Objects.)

default/32518-1.htm.text: Vortex: Vortex of confusion... One piece... Mysterious power... Aerial Cleft... This place is a battlefield where one can enter through a small vortex hall, which releases mysterious energy. When you register, you can choose between red and blue teams. When a number of members for each team is over…
